defects: Uses the raw `Representation R H` type instead of the bundled category `Rep k H`/`Rep k G`; `Representation` requires three type arguments (k, G, V) and has no Category instance on its own, so `ShortComplex (Representation R H)` is not a well-formed category object as in gold's `ShortComplex (Rep k G)`
Cites `Representation.restrict f`, which does not correspond to any known Mathlib declaration for this operation; gold uses `resFunctor f` on the bundled `Rep` category (`Rep.res`/`Rep.resFunctor`)
Strengthens the hypotheses from `Monoid G`, `Monoid H` (gold) to `Group G`, `Group H` (produced), restricting the theorem to groups instead of general monoids
Weakens the ring hypothesis from `CommRing k` (gold's effective, shadowing instance) to `Ring R` (produced), changing the class of coefficient rings covered by the claim
